newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Petsec says identifies new gas zones.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Petsec says identifies new gas zones.

text.p: Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd said on Thursday it had identified new gas zones in its latest two discovery wells in the Gulf of Mexico.
Three separate zones with a combined total of 30 metres of true vertical thickness had been identified in the South Marsh Island 7-1 well, the company said.
South Marsh Island 7-1 was preparing to drill ahead to test remaining primary target zones, the company said.
Another two zones had been identified in final tests of the West Cameron 1 well, taking the total number of gas zones in the well to seven with a combined gas pay of 34 metres.
PetSec's share price has risen from A$5.60 at the start of the year to A$6.40 at Thursday's close after the company reported several oil and gas discoveries in the Gulf of Mexico.
